audit.why: Favoured early, lost late — FAVOURED 4/10 matches 52.34% over 428 games; packet chart Pantheon through first item, Vladimir at 2+ items.
Pantheon spikes 2/3-5/6/first item; Vlad spikes on HP-AP items and pool ranks. All 4 spikes[] present and consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] labels Sanguine Pool '(E, later W)' — Pool is his W (28/25/22/19/16s), Tides of Blood is E. dosFull[2].d claims a 'fifteen-second invitation' with no source; Pool is 28s at rank 1, 16s max. breakdown.cooldowns has no digits.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: Q Transfusion 9-4.6s heal, W Sanguine Pool 28s untargetable 2s, E Tides of Blood blockable by minions, R Hemoplague 120s amp+heal.
audit.corrected: Pool (W) 28s rank 1; commit in its downtime. Anti-heal for Transfusion/Hemoplague.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pool named as defining cooldown, no duration anywhere.
audit.why: 28s rank 1 downtime is the whole kill window.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d.

audit.why: report[8] already calls for early anti-heal into his sustain — covers the needs-antiheal missing interaction.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Check it before every step-up. - E Aegis Assault is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool (W): 28s at rank 1 and only 2s of immunity — bait it, wait the 2 seconds, then all-in the 28s hole it leaves. - His Transfusion runs 9s early, so trade right after it. - Your E Aegis Assault (22s) is the lifeline; the ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At level 2 he has no Sanguine Pool worth the mana-free name — W-stun and cash empowered Q before he can heal it back.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the 28-second invitation.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-first-item his Transfusion heals back every poke trade at 600 range — burst him whole or leave him alone entirely.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two items in, Hemoplague and pool healing outlast your full combo — R still opens fights for your team, but the duel is his now.

edits.before: Vlad is weakest here and pays health to cast, so every point of poke you land compounds: W-stun into empowered Q punishes him hard, and his only escape is Sanguine Pool (E, later W) on a long early cooldown. Bait the pool then all-in, and keep the wave shoved so he burns HP to farm with Transfusion (Q) under pressure.
edits.after: Vlad is weakest here and pays health to cast, so every point of poke you land compounds: W-stun into empowered Q punishes him hard, and his only escape is Sanguine Pool (W) on a 28-second early cooldown. Bait the pool then all-in, and keep the wave shoved so he burns HP to farm with Transfusion (Q) under pressure.
